# Code Anchors: Committed Queue

- `.nexus/queue/` — the committed queue surface: one folder per epic, named for the epic's issue number, holding gated human artifacts and per-user engineer scratch.
- `.claude/commands/nxs.epic.md` — under issue-sourced planning files the epic and story issues and commits nothing to this queue; the entry is no longer created at planning.
- `.claude/commands/nxs.close.md` — resolves the entry directory dual — a pre-existing `epic.md`-carrying directory, or born-at-close into the same directory scratch capture already wrote to — and writes the close record there in PR and old-contract modes only; an issue-sourced local close writes to the ephemeral area instead and commits nothing here.
- `.claude/commands/nxs.distill.md` — scans this surface for entries alongside the ephemeral area, and rides each consumed entry's removal on the distillation branch.
- `.claude/commands/nxs.decision-record.md` — resolves a committed entry by requiring `epic.md` presence, so a scratch-only `epic-<issue>/` directory is never mistaken for one.
- `.nexus/config/templates/close-record-template.md` — the close-record shape, including the record reference and approved-body hash frontmatter.
- `common/templates/close-record-template.md` — the deployable copy of that template.
- `CLAUDE.md` — the authoring rule that places per-user decision scratch inside the epic's queue entry, keyed on the epic issue number.
